cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF' 2>&1 | tail -20
import sys, traceback
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from public_runner import PublicRunner, InfrastructureError
import json, pathlib
fixtures = json.loads(pathlib.Path('examples.json').read_text())
try:
    with PublicRunner(pathlib.Path('submission'), None, site='/workspace/site') as sb:
        case=fixtures[0]
        data = json.dumps(case['request'], separators=(',', ':')).encode()
        r = sb.invoke(data, timeout=60)
        print('rc',r.returncode, r.seconds)
        print(r.stdout[:200])
        print('ERR', r.stderr[:2000])
except Exception as e:
    traceback.print_exc()
